subtitle: 比較高中生 2015 年與 2025 年的早餐選擇
task: The table shows where 500 high school students in one city got their breakfast on school days in 2015 and 2025 (fictional data). Summarize the information and make comparisons where relevant.
taskZh: 表格是某城市 500 位高中生在 2015 年與 2025 年上學日早餐從哪裡來的調查結果（虛構資料）。請摘要資訊，並在適當處做比較。

chart.title: Where 500 high school students got breakfast on school days (%)

focus: 比較兩個年份的變化，而不只是逐行列數字

en: The table compares where 500 high school students got their breakfast on school days in 2015 and 2025.

In 2015, traditional Taiwanese breakfast was the most common choice, at 40 percent. Western-style breakfast shops came second at 30 percent, while convenience stores and skipping breakfast each accounted for 15 percent.

By 2025, the picture had changed considerably. The share of students buying breakfast at convenience stores doubled to 30 percent, and Western-style shops rose slightly to 35 percent, becoming the most popular option. In contrast, traditional breakfast fell from 40 percent to 25 percent. The proportion of students who skipped breakfast also dropped, from 15 percent to 10 percent.
Overall, convenience stores gained the most ground over the decade, mainly at the expense of traditional breakfast, and fewer students went without a morning meal.
zh: 這個表格比較 500 位高中生在 2015 年與 2025 年上學日的早餐從哪裡來。
2015 年，傳統台式早餐是最常見的選擇，佔 40%。西式早餐店排名第二，佔 30%，而便利商店和不吃早餐則各佔 15%。
到了 2025 年，情況有了相當大的改變。在便利商店買早餐的學生比例加倍為 30%，西式早餐店則小幅上升到 35%，成為最受歡迎的選項。相較之下，傳統早餐從 40% 降到 25%。不吃早餐的學生比例也下降了，從 15% 降到 10%。
整體而言，十年間便利商店的成長最多，主要是取代了傳統早餐，而不吃早餐的學生也變少了。
